## Description

**Post-closure regression follow-up to #2724 (mobile swipe navigation) and #1051 (one navigation owner per App Workspace depth).** Those issues were completed and have their own historical Acceptance records; this Bug tracks a **newly identified cross-capability transition not exercised by that proof**. Preserve their closed state and prior receipts.

On App, opening Files at a pushed depth and then selecting another capability from the **always-visible Workspace Capability Capsule** leaves the previous capability's depth flag active in the App's top-level swipe pager. The visible new capability is at its root (and shows “Back to terminal”), but the pager continues to deny the root's return swipe. This violates the current active-capability navigation contract and the product principle that switching contextual tools should not expose inconsistent global navigation.

**Evidence baseline:** current `main`, reviewed 2026-11-05; [original static investigation](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/2724#issuecomment-6658916639). This issue is based on a deterministic React state/code-path contradiction, **not a claim of completed browser reproduction**.

## Reproduction

1. Use the App (narrow/mobile) Workspace, select **Files**, and open a file or enter a folder so that its view registers a pushed depth through `depth.setPush({title, onLeave})`.
2. Without pressing the Files Back action, select **Agent** (or another capability with a root view) using the Workspace Capability Capsule, which is intentionally available at every depth under #1347.
3. The panel renders the Agent root and its header's `Back to terminal` action, but the App shell's `workspaceDetailPushed` state remains `true`; rightward shell return swipe is suppressed.
4. Observe that the root's visible Back action and its top-level gesture disagree. The same logical hazard exists for switching away from Environment detail.

**Minimal source-state derivation:**

- [`WorkspacePanel.tsx`](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/WorkspacePanel.tsx) stores `pushed = { capabilityId: 'files', push }`. The effective visible depth is already capability-guarded: `const push = pushed && pushed.capabilityId === tool ? pushed.push : null`.
- But its effect exports `onDepthChange?.(pushed !== null)`, rather than current effective depth, and depends only on `pushed, onDepthChange`. Switching `tool` to `agent` neither clears `pushed` nor reruns the effect with `false`.
- [`AppLayout.tsx`](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/app/AppLayout.tsx) holds `workspaceDetailPushed` based on that callback.
- [`AppLayers.tsx`](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/app/AppLayers.tsx) passes `shellMayPage: !(layer === 'workspace' && workspaceDetailPushed)`. Therefore a **root** remains fenced as if it were a pushed editor.
- [`useAppFilesShellPush.ts`](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/app/useAppFilesShellPush.ts) and `EnvAppLayout.tsx` set the push on their own effects; there is no corresponding unmount cleanup that would reset the parent to root on a peer-capability switch.
- Existing [`WorkspacePanel.test.tsx`](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/__tests__/integration/WorkspacePanel.test.tsx) covers push, pop and panel unmount but not switching `tool` while a different capability owns a push. Existing AppLayout/AppLayers tests cover manually pushed boolean cases, not the cross-capability transition.

## Root Cause

The Workspace has **two conflicting projections** of one navigation fact:

- Displayed App depth: `pushed?.capabilityId === tool ? pushed.push : null` (correctly active-capability-scoped).
- Published App pager depth: `pushed !== null` (stale owner not scoped to current `tool`).

The latter is forwarded to the shell as authoritative and survives a capability switch. A stale `setPush` callback from a retired capability should likewise not be allowed to retake ownership after switching; this is a focused negative regression to test, not an independently runtime-confirmed second defect.

## Impact

- An App user can lose the Workspace-root swipe shortcut after switching capabilities, even though the new view and Back header are at root.
- App navigation incorrectly depends on historical depth from an unrelated capability; the discrepancy makes interaction behavior unreliable and could complicate future dynamic Workspace capability composition.
- **No assertion of data loss:** current visible Back remains, and the existing dirty-editor guard must be preserved.

## Fix Direction

- Keep one depth owner in `WorkspacePanel`; export the **effective active-capability depth** to `onDepthChange`, including when `tool` changes, rather than `pushed !== null`.
- Bound late callbacks to the capability generation/identity and ensure an old view's delayed cleanup/update cannot replace the active capability's depth.
- Keep approved #1347 capability switching while pushed, #1051's per-depth visible Back and dirty-edit confirmation, and #2724's touch arbitration. **Do not** introduce a second navigation system, hide the Capsule or redesign swipe thresholds.

**Non-goals:** No change to the AI Workspace/System One proposal (#2221), terminal routing, browser native gestures, desktop Web layout or Files edit persistence.

## Location

- `web/src/app/WorkspacePanel.tsx`
- `web/src/app/workspace/WorkspaceShell.tsx`
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/AppLayout.tsx`
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/AppLayers.tsx`
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/useAppFilesShellPush.ts`
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/EnvAppLayout.tsx`
- `web/src/app/__tests__/integration/WorkspacePanel.test.tsx`
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/__tests__/integration/AppLayout.test.tsx`

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 In App Workspace, after Files detail → Capsule switch to Agent root, the visible App header is at Agent root and the top-level return swipe to Terminal is enabled; the previous Files pushed-depth guard is not exported as Agent's current depth.
- [ ] SC-02 Switching Agent root → Files/Environment depth and back preserves correct depth-specific swipe ownership: pushed detail prevents shell swipe bypass, dirty editor leave still requires its own confirmation, and no retired capability callback can re-disable or incorrectly enable the current capability's navigation.
- [ ] SC-03 Exact PR-head Chromium/Playwright App interaction exercises the full cross-capability transition using emulated touch at the canonical narrow viewport(s), asserting actual route on release, correct visible Back, and no unintended edit discard; existing #2724 root/detail swipe behavior remains intact.

**SC → scenario/proof mapping:** SC-01/02/03 = **SCN-02 Web/App interaction**. Use the already approved Chromium + Playwright browser Case lane at **PR head**, with deterministic App fixture, real capability switch, touch release and DOM/route/dirty-guard assertions. Source-aligned verifier: existing `web/src/app/__tests__/integration/WorkspacePanel.test.tsx` and `AppLayout.test.tsx` for narrow deterministic regression; extend existing App browser E2E (`fixture-app.spec.ts`) or a new issue-owned browser Case for trusted SC acceptance. No phone/Safari/native OS proof or credential is required. Evidence must identify exact SHA, viewport, action/observed outcome, Case Run/Attempt and zero skips. SC-03 is explicitly browser proof, not a claim that unit tests alone suffice.
